def WeightedGraph.size (g : WeightedGraph) : Nat :=

namespace Dijk

/-- Tentative-distance map lookup (`none` means "+infinity"). -/
def get (D : Array (Option Int)) (v : Nat) : Option Int := (D[v]?).getD none

/-- Tentative-distance map update. -/
def upd (D : Array (Option Int)) (v : Nat) (x : Int) : Array (Option Int) :=
  D.set! v (some x)

/-- Relax the outgoing edges `es` of a node whose settled distance is `du`.
    Only nodes still in the frontier `unvis` are improved. -/
def relax (du : Int) (unvis : List Nat) (D : Array (Option Int)) :
    List (Nat × Int) → Array (Option Int)
  | [] => D
  | (v, w) :: rest =>
      if v ∈ unvis then
        match get D v with
        | none => relax du unvis (upd D v (du + w)) rest
        | some dv =>
            if du + w < dv then relax du unvis (upd D v (du + w)) rest
            else relax du unvis D rest
      else relax du unvis D rest

/-- Pick the better of two candidate (node, key) pairs. -/
def better : Option (Nat × Int) → Option (Nat × Int) → Option (Nat × Int)
  | none, x => x
  | some p, none => some p
  | some p, some q => if p.2 ≤ q.2 then some p else some q

/-- The candidate contributed by a single frontier node. -/
def cand (D : Array (Option Int)) (v : Nat) : Option (Nat × Int) :=
  match get D v with
  | none => none
  | some d => some (v, d)

/-- Priority-queue extract-min: the frontier node with the least finite key. -/
def selectMin (D : Array (Option Int)) : List Nat → Option (Nat × Int)
  | [] => none
  | v :: rest => better (cand D v) (selectMin D rest)

/-- One round: extract the minimum, settle it, relax its outgoing edges. -/
def loop (g : WeightedGraph) : Nat → List Nat → Array (Option Int) → Array (Option Int)
  | 0, _, D => D
  | fuel + 1, unvis, D =>
      match selectMin D unvis with
      | none => D
      | some (u, du) =>
          loop g fuel (unvis.erase u)
            (relax du (unvis.erase u) D (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList)

def run (g : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) : Array (Option Int) :=
  loop g g.size (List.range g.size) (upd (Array.replicate g.size none) start 0)

/-- There is a walk from `start` to `v` of total weight `d`. -/
def Reaches (g : WeightedGraph) (start v : Nat) (d : Int) : Prop :=
  ∃ p : List Nat, p ≠ [] ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧
    g.path_has_weight p d

/-- The full loop invariant; `b` is the key of the most recently settled node. -/
def Inv (g : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) (unvis : List Nat)
    (D : Array (Option Int)) (b : Int) : Prop :=
  D.size = g.size ∧
  unvis.Nodup ∧
  (∀ v ∈ unvis, v < g.size) ∧
  (∀ v d, get D v = some d → 0 ≤ d) ∧
  get D start = some 0 ∧
  (∀ v d, get D v = some d → Reaches g start v d) ∧
  (∀ v, v < g.size → v ∉ unvis → ∃ d, get D v = some d ∧ d ≤ b) ∧
  (∀ v ∈ unvis, ∀ d, get D v = some d → b ≤ d) ∧
  (∀ x, x < g.size → x ∉ unvis → ∀ pr ∈ g.adj.getD x #[],
      ∃ dx dv, get D x = some dx ∧ get D pr.1 = some dv ∧ dv ≤ dx + pr.2)

/-- What holds when the loop is finished. -/
def Good (g : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) (D : Array (Option Int)) : Prop :=
  D.size = g.size ∧
  get D start = some 0 ∧
  (∀ v d, get D v = some d → Reaches g start v d) ∧
  (∀ x dx, get D x = some dx → ∀ pr ∈ g.adj.getD x #[],
      ∃ dv, get D pr.1 = some dv ∧ dv ≤ dx + pr.2)

end Dijk

namespace Dijk

/-! ### Array layer -/

lemma size_upd (D : Array (Option Int)) (v : Nat) (x : Int) :
    (upd D v x).size = D.size := by
  simp [upd]

lemma lt_of_get {D : Array (Option Int)} {v : Nat} {d : Int}
    (h : get D v = some d) : v < D.size := by
  by_contra hc
  rw [get, Array.getElem?_eq_none (Nat.le_of_not_lt hc)] at h
  simp at h

lemma get_upd (D : Array (Option Int)) (v w : Nat) (x : Int) :
    get (upd D v x) w = if w = v ∧ v < D.size then some x else get D w := by
  by_cases hv : v < D.size
  · by_cases hw : w = v
    · subst hw
      simp [get, upd, hv]
    · simp only [get, upd, Array.set!]
      rw [Array.getElem?_setIfInBounds]
      simp [hw, Ne.symm hw]
  · have : upd D v x = D := by
      simp [upd, Array.set!, Array.setIfInBounds, Nat.not_lt.mp hv]
    rw [this]
    simp [hv]

lemma toList_getD (D : Array (Option Int)) (v : Nat) :
    D.toList.getD v none = get D v := by
  simp [get, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]

/-! ### Relaxation -/

lemma relax_size (du : Int) (unvis : List Nat) :
    ∀ (es : List (Nat × Int)) (D : Array (Option Int)),
      (relax du unvis D es).size = D.size := by
  intro es
  induction es with
  | nil => intro D; simp [relax]
  | cons p rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨v, w⟩ := p
    intro D
    rw [relax]
    split
    · split
      · rw [ih]; exact size_upd _ _ _
      · split
        · rw [ih]; exact size_upd _ _ _
        · exact ih D
    · exact ih D

lemma relax_not_mem (du : Int) (unvis : List Nat) (x : Nat) (hx : x ∉ unvis) :
    ∀ (es : List (Nat × Int)) (D : Array (Option Int)),
      get (relax du unvis D es) x = get D x := by
  intro es
  induction es with
  | nil => intro D; simp [relax]
  | cons p rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨v, w⟩ := p
    intro D
    rw [relax]
    split
    · rename_i hmem
      have hne : x ≠ v := by rintro rfl; exact hx hmem
      split
      · rw [ih, get_upd]; simp [hne]
      · split
        · rw [ih, get_upd]; simp [hne]
        · exact ih D
    · exact ih D

lemma relax_mono (du : Int) (unvis : List Nat) (x : Nat) :
    ∀ (es : List (Nat × Int)) (D : Array (Option Int)) (d0 : Int),
      get D x = some d0 →
      ∃ d, get (relax du unvis D es) x = some d ∧ d ≤ d0 := by
  intro es
  induction es with
  | nil => intro D d0 h; exact ⟨d0, by simpa [relax] using h, le_refl _⟩
  | cons p rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨v, w⟩ := p
    intro D d0 h
    rw [relax]
    split
    · split
      · rename_i hnone
        have hne : x ≠ v := by rintro rfl; rw [hnone] at h; exact absurd h (by simp)
        obtain ⟨d, hd, hle⟩ := ih (upd D v (du + w)) d0 (by rw [get_upd]; simp [hne, h])
        exact ⟨d, hd, hle⟩
      · rename_i dv hsome
        split
        · rename_i hlt
          by_cases hne : x = v
          · subst hne
            rw [hsome] at h
            have hd0 : dv = d0 := by simpa using h
            obtain ⟨d, hd, hle⟩ := ih (upd D x (du + w)) (du + w)
              (by rw [get_upd]; simp [lt_of_get hsome])
            exact ⟨d, hd, by omega⟩
          · obtain ⟨d, hd, hle⟩ := ih (upd D v (du + w)) d0 (by rw [get_upd]; simp [hne, h])
            exact ⟨d, hd, hle⟩
        · exact ih D d0 h
    · exact ih D d0 h

lemma relax_spec (du : Int) (unvis : List Nat) (x : Nat) :
    ∀ (es : List (Nat × Int)) (D : Array (Option Int)) (d : Int),
      get (relax du unvis D es) x = some d →
      get D x = some d ∨ ∃ pr ∈ es, pr.1 = x ∧ d = du + pr.2 := by
  intro es
  induction es with
  | nil => intro D d h; left; simpa [relax] using h
  | cons p rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨v, w⟩ := p
    intro D d h
    rw [relax] at h
    have key : ∀ (D' : Array (Option Int)),
        get (relax du unvis D' rest) x = some d →
        (get D' x = some d ∨ ∃ pr ∈ rest, pr.1 = x ∧ d = du + pr.2) := fun D' h' => ih D' d h'
    split at h
    · split at h
      · rcases key _ h with h1 | ⟨pr, hpr, hpr1, hpr2⟩
        · rw [get_upd] at h1
          by_cases hc : x = v ∧ v < D.size
          · simp [hc] at h1
            right
            exact ⟨(v, w), by simp, by simpa using hc.1.symm, by simpa using h1.symm⟩
          · simp [hc] at h1; exact Or.inl h1
        · right; exact ⟨pr, by simp [hpr], hpr1, hpr2⟩
      · split at h
        · rcases key _ h with h1 | ⟨pr, hpr, hpr1, hpr2⟩
          · rw [get_upd] at h1
            by_cases hc : x = v ∧ v < D.size
            · simp [hc] at h1
              right
              exact ⟨(v, w), by simp, by simpa using hc.1.symm, by simpa using h1.symm⟩
            · simp [hc] at h1; exact Or.inl h1
          · right; exact ⟨pr, by simp [hpr], hpr1, hpr2⟩
        · rcases key _ h with h1 | ⟨pr, hpr, hpr1, hpr2⟩
          · exact Or.inl h1
          · right; exact ⟨pr, by simp [hpr], hpr1, hpr2⟩
    · rcases key _ h with h1 | ⟨pr, hpr, hpr1, hpr2⟩
      · exact Or.inl h1
      · right; exact ⟨pr, by simp [hpr], hpr1, hpr2⟩

lemma relax_edge (du : Int) (unvis : List Nat) :
    ∀ (es : List (Nat × Int)) (D : Array (Option Int)) (pr : Nat × Int),
      pr ∈ es → pr.1 ∈ unvis → pr.1 < D.size →
      ∃ dv, get (relax du unvis D es) pr.1 = some dv ∧ dv ≤ du + pr.2 := by
  intro es
  induction es with
  | nil => intro D pr hpr; simp at hpr
  | cons q rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨v, w⟩ := q
    intro D pr hpr hmem hlt
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hpr with heq | htail
    · subst heq
      have hmem' : v ∈ unvis := hmem
      have hlt' : v < D.size := hlt
      show ∃ dv, get (relax du unvis D ((v, w) :: rest)) v = some dv ∧ dv ≤ du + w
      rw [relax, if_pos hmem']
      split
      · obtain ⟨d, hd, hle⟩ := relax_mono du unvis v rest (upd D v (du + w)) (du + w)
          (by rw [get_upd]; simp [hlt'])
        exact ⟨d, hd, hle⟩
      · rename_i dv hsome
        split
        · obtain ⟨d, hd, hle⟩ := relax_mono du unvis v rest (upd D v (du + w)) (du + w)
            (by rw [get_upd]; simp [hlt'])
          exact ⟨d, hd, hle⟩
        · rename_i hnlt
          obtain ⟨d, hd, hle⟩ := relax_mono du unvis v rest D dv hsome
          exact ⟨d, hd, by omega⟩
    · rw [relax]
      split
      · split
        · exact ih _ pr htail hmem (by rw [size_upd]; exact hlt)
        · split
          · exact ih _ pr htail hmem (by rw [size_upd]; exact hlt)
          · exact ih D pr htail hmem hlt
      · exact ih D pr htail hmem hlt

/-! ### Extract-min -/

lemma selectMin_mem (D : Array (Option Int)) :
    ∀ (l : List Nat) (u : Nat) (du : Int), selectMin D l = some (u, du) →
      u ∈ l ∧ get D u = some du := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro u du h; simp [selectMin] at h
  | cons v rest ih =>
    intro u du h
    rw [selectMin] at h
    have hcase : cand D v = some (u, du) ∨ selectMin D rest = some (u, du) := by
      cases hc : cand D v with
      | none => rw [hc] at h; simp only [better] at h; exact Or.inr h
      | some p =>
        cases hs : selectMin D rest with
        | none =>
          rw [hc, hs] at h; simp only [better] at h; exact Or.inl h
        | some q =>
          rw [hc, hs] at h; simp only [better] at h
          by_cases hpq : p.2 ≤ q.2
          · rw [if_pos hpq] at h; exact Or.inl h
          · rw [if_neg hpq] at h; exact Or.inr h
    rcases hcase with hc | hs
    · unfold cand at hc
      cases hd : get D v with
      | none => rw [hd] at hc; simp at hc
      | some d =>
        rw [hd] at hc
        simp at hc
        obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hc
        subst h1; subst h2
        exact ⟨by simp, hd⟩
    · obtain ⟨k1, k2⟩ := ih u du hs
      exact ⟨List.mem_cons_of_mem _ k1, k2⟩

lemma cand_none (D : Array (Option Int)) (a : Nat) (hc : cand D a = none) :
    get D a = none := by
  unfold cand at hc
  cases hx : get D a with
  | none => rfl
  | some y => rw [hx] at hc; simp at hc

lemma cand_some (D : Array (Option Int)) (a : Nat) (p : Nat × Int) (hc : cand D a = some p) :
    p = (a, p.2) ∧ get D a = some p.2 := by
  unfold cand at hc
  cases hx : get D a with
  | none => rw [hx] at hc; simp at hc
  | some y =>
    rw [hx] at hc
    have hp : p = (a, y) := by simpa using hc.symm
    subst hp
    exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

lemma selectMin_none (D : Array (Option Int)) : ∀ (l : List Nat),
    selectMin D l = none → ∀ v ∈ l, get D v = none := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro _ v hv; simp at hv
  | cons a rest ih =>
    intro h v hv
    rw [selectMin] at h
    have hda : get D a = none ∧ selectMin D rest = none := by
      cases hc : cand D a with
      | none =>
        rw [hc] at h
        simp only [better] at h
        exact ⟨cand_none D a hc, h⟩
      | some p =>
        rw [hc] at h
        cases hs : selectMin D rest with
        | none => rw [hs] at h; simp only [better] at h; exact Option.noConfusion h
        | some q =>
          rw [hs] at h; simp only [better] at h
          split at h <;> exact Option.noConfusion h
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hv with rfl | hvt
    · exact hda.1
    · exact ih hda.2 v hvt

lemma selectMin_min (D : Array (Option Int)) :
    ∀ (l : List Nat) (u : Nat) (du : Int), selectMin D l = some (u, du) →
      ∀ v ∈ l, ∀ d, get D v = some d → du ≤ d := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro u du h; simp [selectMin] at h
  | cons a rest ih =>
    intro u du h v hv d hd
    rw [selectMin] at h
    cases hc : cand D a with
    | none =>
      rw [hc] at h
      simp only [better] at h
      have hda : get D a = none := cand_none D a hc
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hv with rfl | hvt
      · rw [hda] at hd; simp at hd
      · exact ih u du h v hvt d hd
    | some p =>
      have hpa := cand_some D a p hc
      rw [hc] at h
      cases hs : selectMin D rest with
      | none =>
        rw [hs] at h
        simp only [better] at h
        have hp : p = (u, du) := by simpa using h
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hv with rfl | hvt
        · have h1 : p.2 = d := Option.some.inj (hpa.2.symm.trans hd)
          have h2 : p.2 = du := by rw [hp]
          omega
        · have hnone := selectMin_none D rest hs v hvt
          rw [hnone] at hd; simp at hd
      | some q =>
        rw [hs] at h
        simp only [better] at h
        split at h
        · rename_i hle
          have hp : p = (u, du) := by simpa using h
          have h2 : p.2 = du := by rw [hp]
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp hv with rfl | hvt
          · have h1 : p.2 = d := Option.some.inj (hpa.2.symm.trans hd)
            omega
          · have h3 := ih q.1 q.2 (by rw [hs]) v hvt d hd
            omega
        · rename_i hnle
          have hq : q = (u, du) := by simpa using h
          have h2 : q.2 = du := by rw [hq]
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp hv with rfl | hvt
          · have h1 : p.2 = d := Option.some.inj (hpa.2.symm.trans hd)
            omega
          · have h3 := ih q.1 q.2 (by rw [hs]) v hvt d hd
            omega

/-! ### Paths -/

lemma phw_snoc (g : WeightedGraph) (u y : Nat) (w : Int) (hw : g.has_edge u y w) :
    ∀ (p : List Nat) (d : Int), p ≠ [] → p.getLast? = some u →
      g.path_has_weight p d → g.path_has_weight (p ++ [y]) (d + w) := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro d h; exact absurd rfl h
  | cons a t ih =>
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      intro d _ hl hp
      simp [WeightedGraph.path_has_weight] at hp
      simp at hl
      subst hl; subst hp
      exact ⟨w, 0, hw, by simp [WeightedGraph.path_has_weight], by ring⟩
    | cons b t' =>
      intro d _ hl hp
      obtain ⟨we, wr, hedge, hrest, hd⟩ := hp
      have hl' : (b :: t').getLast? = some u := by
        rw [List.getLast?_cons_cons] at hl; exact hl
      have := ih wr (by simp) hl' hrest
      refine ⟨we, wr + w, hedge, ?_, by omega⟩
      exact this

lemma reaches_step (g : WeightedGraph) (start u y : Nat) (du w : Int)
    (h : Reaches g start u du) (he : g.has_edge u y w) :
    Reaches g start y (du + w) := by
  obtain ⟨p, hne, hh, hl, hp⟩ := h
  refine ⟨p ++ [y], by simp, ?_, ?_, phw_snoc g u y w he p du hne hl hp⟩
  · cases p with
    | nil => exact absurd rfl hne
    | cons a t => simpa using hh
  · simp

lemma is_path_of_phw (g : WeightedGraph) :
    ∀ (p : List Nat) (w : Int), p ≠ [] → g.path_has_weight p w → g.is_path p := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro w h; exact absurd rfl h
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro w _ hp
    cases t with
    | nil => exact ⟨by simp, by intro i hi; simp at hi⟩
    | cons b t' =>
      obtain ⟨we, wr, hedge, hrest, _⟩ := hp
      obtain ⟨_, hrec⟩ := ih wr (by simp) hrest
      refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
      intro i hi
      cases i with
      | zero => exact ⟨we, by simpa using hedge⟩
      | succ j =>
        have hj : j + 1 < (b :: t').length := by simp at hi ⊢; omega
        have := hrec j hj
        simpa using this

lemma phw_exists (g : WeightedGraph) :
    ∀ (p : List Nat), p ≠ [] → g.is_path p → ∃ w, g.path_has_weight p w := by
  intro p

lemma loop_good (g : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat)
    (hwf : g.well_formed) (hnn : g.weights_non_negative) :
    ∀ (fuel : Nat) (unvis : List Nat) (D : Array (Option Int)) (b : Int),
      Inv g start unvis D b → unvis.length ≤ fuel →
      Good g start (loop g fuel unvis D) := by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
    intro unvis D b hInv hlen
    have : unvis = [] := List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero (Nat.le_zero.mp hlen)
    subst this
    rw [loop]
    exact good_of_inv g start [] D b hInv (by intro v hv; simp at hv)
  | succ n ih =>
    intro unvis D b hInv hlen
    rw [loop]
    cases hsel : selectMin D unvis with
    | none =>
      exact good_of_inv g start unvis D b hInv (selectMin_none D unvis hsel)

      have hstep := inv_step g start hwf hnn unvis D b u du hInv hsel

      have hlen' : (unvis.erase u).length ≤ n := by
        have := List.length_erase_of_mem humem
        omega
      exact ih (unvis.erase u) _ du hstep hlen'
